description: Approval of Details Application pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 4 (Fenestration Strategy) and 25 (Roof Extension) and the partial discharge of Condition 3 (Facing Materials) - in relation to all parts of the condition except part d) and the ‘gates’ referred to under part c) only - of planning permission ref: P2024/0239/FUL, dated 15/10/2024, as amended via non-material amendment ref: P2025/0560/NMA and P2026/0605/NMA
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: INFORMATIVE: This decision notice grants approval of the details submitted pursuant to the discharge of all parts of Condition 3 except part d) and the ‘gates’ referred to under part c) only. In order to fully discharge Condition 3, details which satisfy the requirements of part d) and the remainder of part c) of the condition must be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority prior to their installation.
